items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: We had George Lee, Julia Lee and they band

ctx.x: Benny Goodman heard us on the radio, and he could...brought his band there and he come up. We went up and invited him down...invited his whole band and had barbecue and spaghetti an' everything. And he jus' set and listened...where he heard me sing.

And, uh, later on, then we went to Eighteenth Street. Same I-talian had the club on Independence Avenue when we went to Eighteenth Street--Eighteenth and Vine--called the Sunset Nightclub. Was...used to be a theater, and we got 'em to take all the benches out an' everything an' rented the joint and made a nightclub out of it. Had Count Basie playin' there. We had George Lee, Julia Lee and they band, the musicians' brothers' (?) band, Twelve Clouds of Joy. We had a...let me see...in fact, we had a whole gang of…
And they worked at the Sunset.
